zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX VSR
zh-Hans.summary: 常规、高码率、流媒体、降噪、去模糊，两级选择。
zh-Hans.details: 分类内选择 Low／Medium／High／Ultra；流媒体仅 Medium／Ultra，要求 Ampere 及更新渲染 GPU。降噪与去模糊保持输入尺寸；每类记住自己的档位与缩放。旧 VSR、Denoise 与后缀档位配置继续迁移，档位不会被更名重置。分类改变重启应用，单独档位通过候选模型切换。HDR 通过 SDR 兼容映射处理。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX VSR
en-US.summary: Category and quality selection across five VSR families.
en-US.details: Standard, high bitrate, streaming, denoise, and deblur. Streaming has Medium/Ultra only and needs Ampere or later on the rendering GPU. Denoise/deblur keep the input size; families remember quality and scaling. Existing VSR/Denoise aliases migrate without resetting quality. Category changes require a restart; quality changes load a candidate model. HDR uses an SDR compatibility boundary.
en-US.search: RTXVideo\RTXVideo_VSR Nvidia VFX VSR Category and quality selection across five VSR families. Standard, high bitrate, streaming, denoise, and deblur. Streaming has Medium/Ultra only and needs Ampere or later on the rendering GPU. Denoise/deblur keep the input size; families remember quality and scaling. Existing VSR/Denoise aliases migrate without resetting quality. Category changes require a restart; quality changes load a candidate model. HDR uses an SDR compatibility boundary. RTXVideo\RTXVideo_VSR RTXVideo_VSR Upscaling and super resolution General purpose AI video upscaling with four strength levels. For upscaling video and streams, using the group’s output size. Low/Medium/High/Ultra are processing levels; start at Medium and compare texture and noise.  Requires a supported NVIDIA RTX GPU, driver, and bundled Video Effects runtime. Higher strength is not always a better match. HDR uses SDR-compatible mapping and quantization, so inspect highlights and color. Strength updates live; preparing the new model may temporarily add overhead. zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX TrueHDR
zh-Hans.summary: 将 SDR 扩展为 HDR，包含去色带。
zh-Hans.details: 保留旧 RTX Video HDR 的效果 ID、参数、精确输入和普通／Shift 刻度。对比度、饱和度 0–200（默认 100）；中灰 10–100（50）；峰值 400–2000 nits（1000）。去色带默认开启。配合 VFG 时每张真实／生成帧都处理；HDR 源先转 SDR。输出屏幕开启 Windows HDR。AI 重塑亮度和颜色，不代表恢复原始 HDR。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX TrueHDR
en-US.summary: Expand SDR to HDR with debanding.
en-US.details: Retains the RTX Video HDR ID, parameters, exact integer input and ordinary/Shift steps. Contrast and saturation 0–200 (100), middle gray 10–100 (50), peak 400–2000 nits (1000). Debanding is on by default. With VFG, every real/generated frame is processed. Convert HDR sources to SDR first and enable Windows HDR on the output. AI reshapes brightness and color; it does not recover original HDR.
en-US.search: RTXVideo\RTXVideo_HDR Nvidia VFX TrueHDR Expand SDR to HDR with debanding. Retains the RTX Video HDR ID, parameters, exact integer input and ordinary/Shift steps. Contrast and saturation 0–200 (100), middle gray 10–100 (50), peak 400–2000 nits (1000). Debanding is on by default. With VFG, every real/generated frame is processed. Convert HDR sources to SDR first and enable Windows HDR on the output. AI reshapes brightness and color; it does not recover original HDR. RTXVideo\RTXVideo_HDR RTX Video HDR HDR components  Expand SDR into HDR using NVIDIA AI. Keeps the input size, after the SDR effects section; convert HDR input through HDR → SDR first. AI reshapes brightness and color rather than restoring the original HDR.  Requires a supported NVIDIA RTX GPU, driver, and bundled RTX Video HDR runtime, with Windows HDR enabled on the output display. Set peak brightness for the display, then compare contrast, saturation, and middle gray. All four parameters update live; cost depends on resolution and GPU. zh-Hans.summary: 五档固定倍率，或自动适配目标尺寸。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX Upscale
en-US.summary: Five exact ratios or automatic target fitting.
en-US.details: 4/3x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, or 4x. Automatic mode chooses the lowest legal ratio, then proportionally fits the target with Bicubic; targets beyond 4x use an additional resize. Sharpness 0–1, default 0.4. The running panel shows native dimensions and adaptation.

zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX VFG
zh-Hans.summary: SDR 2–8× 补帧，可逐帧接入 TrueHDR。
zh-Hans.details: Windows x64 需要 Ada／Blackwell 渲染 GPU。性能（Low）／均衡（Medium）两档，默认 2×、均衡、自动场切开启、重复帧过滤关闭。旧 High 设置迁移为均衡。SDR 前置效果 → VFG → 每张真实／生成帧的 TrueHDR 与支持的后置效果 → 呈现；HDR 源先显式转 SDR。首帧仅输出一次，有界队列逐张消费。首版后置支持 TrueHDR、Bicubic、Bilinear、CAS、RCAS；不支持的后置链会提示。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX VFG
en-US.summary: SDR interpolation at 2–8x, with per-output TrueHDR.
en-US.details: Windows x64 requires an Ada/Blackwell rendering GPU. Performance (Low) or Balanced (Medium). Defaults: 2x, Balanced, automatic shot detection enabled and duplicate filtering disabled. Retired High settings migrate to Balanced. SDR pre-effects -> VFG -> TrueHDR and supported post-effects for every real/generated output -> presentation. Convert HDR input explicitly to SDR first. The first frame is published once, and outputs use a bounded queue. Initial post-effects: TrueHDR, Bicubic, Bilinear, CAS, RCAS; unsupported chains are reported.
